cases.label: physical possibility
cases.statement: Available clearance bears on whether the component can rotate.

cases.label: probability
cases.statement: Queue depth bears on the probability of missing the service target.
cases.terrain: current queue depth and arrival rate
cases.referent: probability of exceeding 500 ms latency in the next hour
cases.relocalization_trigger: arrival regime or worker count changes

cases.label: sustainability
cases.statement: Cooling reserve bears on whether the present load can continue without thermal degradation.
cases.referent: sustainability of current processing load for eight hours
cases.evidence: thermal sensors and rated cooling curve
cases.relocalization_trigger: ambient temperature, cooling capacity, or load changes

cases.label: normative permissibility
cases.statement: Documented consent bears on whether the recording is permitted under the named protocol.
cases.terrain: signed consent and current protocol scope
cases.referent: permissibility of retaining the interview recording
cases.evidence: consent form, withdrawal status, and protocol
cases.relocalization_trigger: withdrawal, protocol amendment, or retention-window expiry

cases.label: epistemic license
cases.statement: Cross-validation and drift bounds bear on whether the forecast is defensible.
cases.referent: license to assert a calibrated seven-day forecast
cases.evidence: prospective calibration, coverage, and drift tests
cases.time_state: current model version and evaluation window
cases.relocalization_trigger: coverage failure, change point, or model revision

cases.label: positioned disagreement A
cases.statement: Cash reserve bears on payroll sustainability from the finance position.
cases.referent: sustainability of payroll for twelve weeks
cases.position: finance lead with bank and receivable access
cases.evidence: bank statements and signed receivable schedule
cases.relocalization_trigger: material payment, default, or payroll change

cases.label: positioned disagreement B
cases.statement: The same reserve does not establish team-level workload sustainability.
cases.referent: sustainability of the team's present workload for twelve weeks
cases.position: team lead with workload but no full financial access
cases.evidence: financial summary plus workload records; staffing-cost detail occluded

cases.label: freshness and un-promotion
cases.statement: A maintained referral habit bears on loop sustainability only while the handoff practice remains funded.
cases.evidence: six observed handoffs and follow-up records
cases.relocalization_trigger: missed handoff, role change, or thirty days without observation

cases.label: boundary non-collision
cases.statement: The interface's authentication mode bears on whether a transfer can occur.
cases.terrain: authentication requirement at the API boundary

cases.label: ethical claim mislabeled probability
cases.terrain: signed consent under a named protocol

cases.label: prediction license mislabeled permission
cases.statement: The model is permitted to predict because its errors are stable.
cases.referent: whether the probability assertion is epistemically licensed

cases.label: stale assignment without trigger
cases.statement: Last year's staffing level sustains this quarter's workload.

cases.label: missing evidence
cases.resolution: two partners over the next quarter
cases.relocalization_trigger: first failed handoff or monthly review
